Folders of a Where To Work project

Source: R/wtw.R
wtw_project_folders.Rd

The folders of a Where To Work (WTW) project, as paths relative to the project folder: the default folders of create_wtw_project_folder(). Without layers, it is the layout wtw-data-prep2's step 01 creates, with a fixed list of theme and weight folders. With layers, the theme and weight folders are those extract_wtw_natdata() writes the layers to, so the layout follows a NAT_DATA catalogue as it changes.

Usage

wtw_project_folders(layers = NULL)

Arguments

layers

NULL (the default) for wtw-data-prep2's theme and weight folders, or a data frame of layers with a subdir column, such as the catalogue read_natdata_metadata() returns (whose subdir is each layer's NAT_DATA folder, for example "themes/species/eccc_ch"). Each layer's subdir gives the folder tifs/<subdir>, the folder extract_wtw_natdata() writes it to. NA and "" add no folder (those layers are written to tifs itself); other columns are ignored.

Value

A character vector of folder paths relative to the project folder, sorted, with / between folder names.

Method

The folders are, as paths with / between folder names:

  • always: aoi; tifs with tifs/themes, tifs/weights, tifs/includes and tifs/excludes; wtw with wtw/metadata and wtw/runs; and dataprep with dataprep/national, dataprep/regional and dataprep/tmp;

  • with layers = NULL, wtw-data-prep2's theme and weight folders: tifs/themes/species with one folder per species source (eccc_ch, eccc_sar, iucn_amph, iucn_bird, iucn_rept, iucn_mamm, nsc_end, nsc_sar, nsc_spp, ncc_sdm and ncc_sar_aoh), tifs/themes/habitat, and tifs/weights with carbon, climate, connectivity, eservices, pressures and hotspots;

  • with layers, tifs/<subdir> for each layer's subdir instead, with backslashes turned into /, repeated / and a leading ./ or trailing / removed.

The folders above each folder are added (tifs/themes/species for tifs/themes/species/eccc_ch), repeats are removed and the list is sorted by byte (C locale), so each folder comes after the folder it is in and the order is the same on every system.

With layers = NULL, the folders are the 32 that wtw-data-prep2's create_project_folder() creates. With NAT_DATA_20261009's catalogue (its active layers) they are the same 32 folders. Decisions are recorded in ADR 0021.

See also

read_natdata_metadata(), which reads a NAT_DATA catalogue.

Other wtw: create_dataprep_template(), create_wtw_planning_units(), create_wtw_project_folder(), dataprep_columns(), extract_wtw_natdata()

Examples

# wtw-data-prep2's layout
wtw_project_folders()
#>  [1] "aoi"                             "dataprep"                       
#>  [3] "dataprep/national"               "dataprep/regional"              
#>  [5] "dataprep/tmp"                    "tifs"                           
#>  [7] "tifs/excludes"                   "tifs/includes"                  
#>  [9] "tifs/themes"                     "tifs/themes/habitat"            
#> [11] "tifs/themes/species"             "tifs/themes/species/eccc_ch"    
#> [13] "tifs/themes/species/eccc_sar"    "tifs/themes/species/iucn_amph"  
#> [15] "tifs/themes/species/iucn_bird"   "tifs/themes/species/iucn_mamm"  
#> [17] "tifs/themes/species/iucn_rept"   "tifs/themes/species/ncc_sar_aoh"
#> [19] "tifs/themes/species/ncc_sdm"     "tifs/themes/species/nsc_end"    
#> [21] "tifs/themes/species/nsc_sar"     "tifs/themes/species/nsc_spp"    
#> [23] "tifs/weights"                    "tifs/weights/carbon"            
#> [25] "tifs/weights/climate"            "tifs/weights/connectivity"      
#> [27] "tifs/weights/eservices"          "tifs/weights/hotspots"          
#> [29] "tifs/weights/pressures"          "wtw"                            
#> [31] "wtw/metadata"                    "wtw/runs"                       

# The theme and weight folders of a NAT_DATA catalogue
natdata_dir <- system.file("extdata", "natdata", package = "constechr")
wtw_project_folders(read_natdata_metadata(natdata_dir))
#>  [1] "aoi"                 "dataprep"            "dataprep/national"  
#>  [4] "dataprep/regional"   "dataprep/tmp"        "tifs"               
#>  [7] "tifs/excludes"       "tifs/includes"       "tifs/themes"        
#> [10] "tifs/themes/habitat" "tifs/themes/species" "tifs/weights"       
#> [13] "wtw"                 "wtw/metadata"        "wtw/runs"           

# Add a folder to the layout
create_wtw_project_folder(
  file.path(tempdir(), "wtw_extra"),
  c(wtw_project_folders(), "tifs/themes/regional")
)
